name: Raihan Khan
description: **Raihan Khan** is a Product & AI Engineer and a Member of Technical Staff at **Graphify Labs (YC S26)**, where he focuses on transforming complex codebases into queryable knowledge graphs for AI assistants. Based in India, Raihan specializes in taking generative AI products from initial concept to deployment, managing both product strategy and technical engineering. He is also the founder of ColdVisit, an automated AI agent designed to test critical user journeys within real browsers during pull requests. Driven by a passion for continuous learning and impactful software development, Raihan combines deep engineering expertise with strong team leadership to build next-generation developer tools and AI systems.
